testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch save-dialog navigation modes ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+S to open Save As ✔ And the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` ✔ And the navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders ✔ And the dialog displays a current folder and proposed file name ✔ When the user switches to system-location navigation ✔ Then the navigation pane displays system locations and drives ✔ And the current folder and proposed file name remain displayed ✔ And the preview settings remain displayed ✔ When the user switches back to recent-folder navigation ✔ Then the navigation pane displays libraries and recent folders ✔ And the current folder and proposed file name remain displayed ✔ When the user cancels Save As ✔ Then the unsaved part remains active
